# IdentityEvent

`schemas/records/identity-event.json`

The payload of every actor and token event (docs/design/m0/04 "Actors and tokens"): &lt;transition&gt;/v1, e.g. actor.created/v1 or token.revoked/v1. Each carries its record as it is after the transition, so a projection is the latest record and a rebuild is a fold. The event's subject is the actor (actor.*) or the token (token.*). internal/identity checks every transition against the current record in the writer transaction.

## Fields of the document

| Field | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `transition` | yes | one of `actor.created`, `actor.revoked`, `token.issued`, `token.revoked` |  |
| `actor` | yes | null or [actor](records-actor.md) |  |
| `token` | yes | null or [token](records-token.md) |  |

No other fields are allowed.

Conditional rules (1, `if`/`then`/`else` in the schema):

- when `transition` one of `actor.created`, `actor.revoked`, then `actor` any (not `null`), `token` `null`; otherwise `actor` `null`, `token` any (not `null`)
